chapter_mission: Confirm to Alliance intelligence — and therefore to the reader — that Centerpoint Station is being reactivated by Corellian engineers. Establish the midpoint engine.
chapter_turn: The political crisis acquires a super-weapon, and the Alliance's calculus pivots from containment to pre-emption.

scene_plan.purpose: Intelligence briefing confirms Centerpoint reactivation work; Omas authorizes preliminary counter-planning.
Jacen parallel-briefed by Alliance-aligned contacts; his stance on pre-emption continues to consolidate.

exit_vector: Cal Omas authorizing initial planning for a Centerpoint counter-operation.
notes: Intelligence-side chapter. Dr. Seyah and Dr. Arisster as technical voices.
